run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit across namespaces whose name starts with 'app-283': the cluster had 4 such namespaces (app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search) out of 11 namespaces total, and each one contains a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest'. Its 'audit_code' value was read for each namespace: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q, app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V, app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z, app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. Each of these ConfigMaps has exactly the data keys audit_code, owner and tier. The values were read as the cluster state at query time (observed_at 2026-11-23T19:18:21Z–19:18:24Z), so they are current readings and not a proven history across the authorized window 2026-10-24T19:18:20Z–2026-11-23T19:18:20Z.
